findings.title: D08 consumes an unfrozen circuit-library dependency
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 4 requires D02 to bind every curriculum-owned domain input used by D08 and reject drift; Criterion 6 requires a deterministic receipt from the exact frozen invocation; Criterion 11 forbids an unverifiable N70 path.
findings.trigger: `curricula/arduino_kit/circuit_library.v1.yaml` changes after D02 compiles the effective run but before D08 executes the verifier.
findings.consequence: The same candidate hash can be accepted or rejected based on post-freeze library bytes while the fixture suite still reports PASS. D08 therefore cannot prove that its verdict came from the frozen effective-run identity.
findings.evidence: The active manifest names the library at `arduino_kit_curriculum.v5.yaml:49-51`, and `verify_domain.py:49-51,257-266` reads it at execution time. `_compile_domain_contract` at `inputs.py:798-811` retains only the config path, not the library digest; `transport.py:1969-1979` grants the verifier read access to the whole engine root. The isolated reproduction `rc14_unfrozen_verifier_dependency_repro.py` reported: `library digest appears in contract: False`; candidate SHA-256 `aa5c7355...` initially produced `PASS PASS`; after changing only the temporary library to `circuits: []`, `candidate sha256 unchanged: True` and the receipt returned `PASS FAIL` with `composed-circuit-invented`. No drift error occurred.

observations: Graph v8 remained at the required SHA-256. Graph v9, schema v6, contract v6, and governing-specification digests all recomputed correctly.
The real plan validator, ownership verifier, complete-tree scanner, and fresh v9 controller plan passed.
The exact focused/package suite passed 972 tests. The full runtime suite passed 1349 tests with 2 skipped and 419 subtests. Five direct regressions covering all six RC13 findings passed.
reasoning: All six RC13 blockers appear closed, and the claimed regression denominators reproduced successfully. RC14-QA-001 survives independent execution: the active verifier has a curriculum-owned sidecar dependency absent from the compiled contract’s digest bindings, so a post-D02 mutation changes the exact candidate verdict without invalidating the fixture receipt. This directly defeats the complete-freeze and executable-verification criteria despite the passing suites.
